text: MCP launch that survives PATH: setup writes an absolute launcher, plus an aimparency doctor check
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: in ~/.claude.json the aimparency MCP was configured as command "tsx" + packages/mcp/src/index.ts. tsx isn't on PATH in Claude Code's environment (it lives in v7/node_modules/.bin), so the server failed with ENOENT and the whole session started without Aimparency. /mcp reconnect fails the same way. The human had to fix it by hand.

Proposal: (1) the setup/install path (install_hooks guide, README, 'Local mode: connect an agent' 37e61205) writes MCP config with an absolute launcher (node + built dist, or the repo-local tsx path) instead of a bare command; (2) a small `aimparency doctor` (CLI + MCP-less) that checks: launcher resolvable, backend ws reachable at 3001, token, graph data model version, and prints the exact config line to paste. Related: d8e9a2b1 (publish as package would also fix this).

Refuted if no further launch failures show up after (1).

status.comment: Accepted by Felix ('can we work on them?'). (1) Absolute launcher: the header's 'Connect an agent' (37e61205, localMcpCommand in backend system.ts) already gives packages/mcp/node_modules/.bin/tsx + src/index.ts by absolute path. The README's Claude Code install already uses an absolute path to build/index.js. The remaining trap was the README's development snippet `node --import tsx <abs>`, which resolves tsx from the client's working directory: it now gives the `claude mcp add --scope user … /abs/.bin/tsx /abs/src/index.ts` line and explains why. Felix's ~/.claude.json was fixed the same way and verified: the server starts from ~/dev/ways-of-will ('Aimparency MCP Server running on stdio'). (2) `aimparency doctor` was not built: by the idea's own refutation test, it's only worth building if launch failures come back after (1).
